hero.name: Maison Chetty
hero.description:
I’m a Software Engineer with a BSc in Information Technology, currently completing my Honours degree.
I build full-stack web applications using React, Next.js and relational databases, focusing on clean and scalable architecture.
I’ve worked on modernizing legacy systems, improving performance, and automating business processes.
I’m comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in Agile environments.
My interests include cloud computing, cybersecurity and system design.
I aim to grow into an engineer who designs reliable systems that create real-world impact.
